problems: Page budgets exceeded for kingdom-of-thailand (4 pages against 1-2) because the first two pages were silent on 1943 and 1945-46; democratic-republic-of-vietnam cites three neighbour pages for occupation events. 20 distinct pages were opened in all; none failed.

Cliopatria errors found: republic-of-indonesia 1950, 1953 and 1960 shapes include western New Guinea until 1 May 1963; its 1976 shape keeps East Timor to 2005 (Indonesia left Oct 1999); its 1949 shape omits West Sumatra; DRV 1973 shape carries PRG/PAVN zones of Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia; Kingdom of Laos 1967 shape cuts the Ho Chi Minh Trail strip; Kingdom of Cambodia 1967 and 1973 shapes drop the north-east and its row starts 1956 and resumes 1996 (State of Cambodia/UNTAC, monarchy restored 24 Sep 1993, overlapped by the PRK row to 1995); Cliopatria's Socialist Republic of Vietnam row starts Jan 1976 but the union is 2 Jul 1976.
Sultanate of Aceh rows (1946-48, 1953-59; sultanate-of-aceh, se-02) overlay land the Republic held or fought over; the Indonesia dossier contests Aceh against negara-islam-indonesia in 1953-62.
Wikidata clashes: Q172640 (DRV and Republic of Vietnam) and Q424 (Cambodia 1700-1802 and Kingdom of Cambodia) treated as different states, no merge.

Two rebel states were written (negara-islam-indonesia, pathet-lao) from one page each; the united-states-of-america dossier should record the Philippines' loss on 4 July 1946, burma/british-colonial-empire/french-indochina the Thai wartime gains, and kingdom-of-thailand has no Preah Vihear event for want of a page.
